latest_release.name: Google Surf MCP v1.1.6
latest_release.body:
Google Surf MCP 1.1.6 improves Auto Ontology, evidence handling, and optional provider setup.

- Adds query-focused evidence, cached follow-up reads, and explicit requirement/gap receipts. The balanced default is preserved; coherent extraction is opt-in.
- Separates ontology schema terms from instance assertions and adds project-, time-, and unit-aware full-population aggregates.
- Fixes pinned E5 tokenizer discovery and fingerprints embedding/runtime compatibility.
- Isolates source-reading browser traffic with DNS-validated, IP-pinned requests and private-network guards.
- Integrates optional OrcaRouter API-key and PKCE setup with CSRF protection, bounded model discovery, and owner-only credential storage.
- Fixes Windows credential-permission validation and updates the manual repair workflow actions without enabling scheduled Google probes.

The release is checked on Linux and Windows with Node.js 22 and 24. Existing research data is preserved; derived vector indexes may need rebuilding after the runtime fingerprint changes.

Known dependency warning: the stealth dependency chain retains a [low-severity deepmerge advisory](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-gcqx-w48m-w2h4) with no upstream patched version. No forced downgrade is applied.
